For typed receipts over P2P (eth/69): `RLP([tx_type, status, cumulative_gas, bloom, logs])`

The issue is in the decoding logic:
1. When `SkipTypedWrapping` is NOT set (default P2P behavior per EIP-2718), typed receipts come as `RLP([tx_type || receipt_data])`
2. Line 40 checks `!ctx.IsSequenceNext()` - this is TRUE when the next byte is NOT an RLP list marker (i.e., it's a string/byte array)
